DRDO signs first major quantum tech deal with startup

The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has signed its first high-value deep-tech project agreement under the Technology Development Fund (TDF) scheme. The deal is with a startup, Zero mK India Private Limited, to indigenously develop a 20 mK dilution refrigerator for quantum applications. The startup is based in Rajasthan.
